title: If Jesus really rose from the dead, Christianity isn’t just a religion — it’s reality.
paragraphs: If Jesus really rose from the dead, Christianity isn’t just a religion — it’s reality.
The empty tomb forces a question every human must answer:
What will you do with Jesus?

If the resurrection actually happened…
that changes everything.

You can ignore church.
You can ignore religion.

But if Jesus walked out of that tomb —
you can’t ignore Him.

If Jesus truly rose from the dead…
that’s the most important event in human history.
What do you think happened that morning? 👀
